players.product: HYFT biological representation, ReefIQ data layer and LensAI platform for AI drug discovery

quarterly_data.signal: MindWalk launched ReefIQ on June 10, 2026: a HYFT-powered biological context layer for AI drug discovery and biologics development that sits between client discovery data and AI reasoning workflows, turning sequences, structures, assay outputs, omics, literature, evidence, provenance and program history into governed, queryable context for LensAI and customer-selected agent models. HYFT, refined over 20 years of curation, is described as a continuously evolving Knowledge Graph of 660 million biological patterns and 25 billion relationships. LensAI is already in contracted, recurring arrangements with life-sciences customers.
quarterly_data.figure: ReefIQ launched June 10, 2026; 660 million biological patterns; 25 billion relationships
